toolsLayout.description: Tools (panel = percentage on panel + tooltip; tooltip only = shown on hover)

showIcons.description: Show tool icons instead of text names on the panel
showIcons.tooltip: When enabled, shows the tool's icon (Claude, AGY or Codex) next to the percentage. When disabled, shows the tool name as text.

claudeShowDay.description: Claude: show daily/session (D) on the panel

claudeShowWeek.description: Claude: show weekly (S) on the panel

agyShowGoogle.description: Antigravity CLI: show Google models (G) on the panel

agyShowOther.description: Antigravity CLI: show other models (O) on the panel

useRelativeTime.description: Show relative time (e.g. 'in 2 hours') instead of formatted date

sessionResetFormat.description: Session Reset Date Format (Claude only, e.g. DD/MM HH:mm)
sessionResetFormat.tooltip: Use DD (day), MM (month), YYYY (year), HH (hour 24h), hh (hour 12h), mm (minute), ss (second), A (AM/PM)

weekResetFormat.description: Week / Quota Reset Date Format (e.g. DD/MM HH:mm)
weekResetFormat.tooltip: Use DD (day), MM (month), YYYY (year), HH (hour 24h), hh (hour 12h), mm (minute), ss (second), A (AM/PM)

useColors.description: Enable colored text on the panel based on usage level

thresholdYellow.description: Threshold for Yellow (Green up to this %)

thresholdRed.description: Threshold for Red (Yellow up to this %)
